basis: Chronic T-cell-mediated inflammatory skin disease; progression to cutaneous lymphoma is a separate later risk.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: parapsoriasis is an immune-mediated cutaneous inflammatory disorder, despite uncertain initiating etiology.

basis: Defining short ribs and pulmonary hypoplasia (2/2); pyloric stenosis causes gastrointestinal obstruction and is reported in 1/1 assessed patient, with substantial sampling uncertainty.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: pyloric stenosis is documented in 1/1 assessed patient; supplied HPO frequency supports inclusion, although the sample is very small.

basis: Autoinflammatory panniculitis/lipodystrophy; characteristic myositis and contractures affect roughly >=30% in PRAAS. Subtype-specific metabolic dysfunction frequency is uncertain.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: lipodystrophy supports skin involvement; hypertriglyceridemia lacks a frequency establishing common intrinsic metabolic involvement.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: inflammatory myositis, arthritis and contractures are characteristic PRAAS manifestations, collectively expected in >=30%; subtype frequencies are limited.

basis: Systemic inflammatory rheumatic syndrome; arthralgia, transient exanthema and reactive leukocytosis do not establish joint, skin or blood damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: the supplied definition establishes arthralgia, without persistent arthritis, structural injury or muscle dysfunction.

basis: Neurometabolic dystonia; hearing impairment and structural foot deformities, including pes cavus and talipes equinovarus, are each annotated at 30-79%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: HPO explicitly reports pes cavus and talipes equinovarus at 30-79%, supporting structural foot involvement beyond dystonic movement alone.

basis: Skeletal asymmetry and variable neurodevelopmental impairment characterize the syndrome; congenital heart defects occur in approximately 50-65%. Pigmented marks alone do not establish skin damage.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: congenital cardiac malformations affect approximately half or more of reported patients and are intrinsic developmental manifestations.

basis: Respiratory ciliopathy with bronchiectasis; hearing impairment occurs in 1/1 annotated patient and commonly (>=30%) in PCD. Thyroid disease is not established as intrinsic.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypothyroidism and goiter in one patient do not establish a causal thyroid manifestation of this ciliopathy; coincident thyroid disease is excluded.

basis: Defining intellectual disability, contractures and osteoporosis; hypogonadism occurs in 80-99% and strabismus in 30-79%. Elevated IgE alone does not establish immune disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypogonadism documents gonadal endocrine dysfunction in 80-99%; it accompanies the defining developmental and skeletal syndrome.

basis: Inherited susceptibility specifies future lymphoma risk without established lymphoma, blood-cell disease, immune dysfunction or existing organ damage.

decisions.haematologic: none: susceptibility to a blood-cell neoplasm does not establish an existing haematologic disease.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: lymphoma susceptibility alone is neither established lymphoma nor an immunodeficiency or immune-mediated disease.

basis: Most tumors cause sustained cortisol excess; skin atrophy/fragility affects >50%, and myopathy or bone loss roughly 50-80%. These are direct hormonal manifestations; silent tumors are a minority.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent skin atrophy and fragility commonly (>50%) result directly from tumor-driven cortisol excess, rather than representing only a future disease risk.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: cortisol-mediated myopathy and bone loss commonly affect roughly 50-80%; hormone excess is the usual functional expression of this tumor.
